rule: Gate then weight: per tile, a one-in-N roll decides whether a landmark exists; a weighted list picks which. Filter by z-band before the roll; skip the collection if nothing fits. Palette parameters carry weighted distributions and fallbacks; default scope is one overmap special, so a building keeps one skin. Nested decoration uses a large null weight. Specials: priority tiers, shuffled first-fit inside a tier, min and max occurrences, mandatory pass first. Rare uniques: a virtual deck (successes of deck_size cards), one draw per eligible overmap, reshuffle when empty.
keep: filter by z-band before the roll
palette parameters with fallbacks, scoped per zone or building
rare nested decoration via null weight
deck draw for rare unique specials
change: seed per-tile roll from zone seed plus tile index so the server can replay it
remove the second pick in the production extra roll (src/mapgen.cpp 296 and 301)
names, symbols, colours, numbers and landmark families are ours
look_test: Six 375-wide stills to /preview/ (no release rows): one room template in three palettes; the same zone at two landmark gate frequencies; one rare unique as random placement in 2 of 6 zones versus a deck guaranteeing 1 per cycle. Dom judges whether landmarks feel like a world worth walking.
